info.title: Neeva AI Backend
info.description: Google-Only Mental Wellness Platform Backend — Cloud Run, Firebase Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Gemini 2.5 Flash (google-genai), Google MuRIL ONNX, Vertex AI Gemma 2 (9B-IT & 2B-IT), and Google Cloud DLP.

post.description: Register a user locally in durable SQLite WAL storage and issue a zero-cost JWT.
Authenticate email & password against durable SQLite WAL storage and return a signed JWT.
Verify current token and ensure user profile exists in durable SQLite WAL storage.
Durably revoke the active JWT and user tokens in SQLite WAL.

delete.description:
Recursively delete the entire user-owned document tree in Cloud Firestore
(profile, preferences, settings, mood logs, streaks, journals, analyses, conversations,
messages, CBT exercises, wellness toolkit, trusted contacts, safety events, and community data).

get.description:
Strict K-Anonymity (K >= 50) SQL aggregation view.
Uses `HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 50`. If active distinct users < 50,
returns an anonymized threshold notice instead of raw numbers.

delete.description: Permanently purge all wellness subcollections and anonymous community posts for the caller.

post.description:
Run distress classification across 8 Indian languages.
Explicitly reports `inference_source` (`"hybrid_deterministic_and_muril_onnx"` when ONNX weights
are loaded vs `"deterministic_multilingual_rules"` when ONNX artifact is absent).

Controlled inference wrapper for Gemma 2 9B-IT (`google/gemma-2-9b-it`).
Always runs the authoritative Three-Tier Safety Engine first; Tier 3 interrupts generation.

Community moderation & structured emotion tagging endpoint for Gemma 2 2B-IT (`google/gemma-2-2b-it`).
Invokes the real Vertex AI endpoint when `VERTEX_GEMMA_2B_ENDPOINT` is configured.
Clearly distinguishes `"vertex_ai_gemma_2_2b_it"` from `"deterministic_fallback"`.
Inspect text for Indian & general PII (local deterministic default in ₹0 mode; opt-in Cloud DLP when enabled).
De-identify/redact PII (local deterministic default in ₹0 mode; opt-in Cloud DLP when enabled).
